title: Deere (DE) earnings Q1 2020
主要内容: Deere (DE) reported an unexpected increase in first-quarter profit for Q1 2020, with net income of $517 million, or $1.63 per share, compared to $498 million, or $1.54 per share, in the same period last year. This surpassed the average analyst estimate of $1.26 per share. The company retained its full-year earnings forecast of $2.7 billion to $3.1 billion for 2020. The rise in profits was attributed to stabilization in the U.S. farm sector, which offset weak demand for construction machines. Deere's shares rose 9% to $180.75 in premarket trade. The company's earnings were previously impacted by the U.S.-China trade war, but hopes for a trade deal with China have boosted expectations for recovery in farm machinery demand. CEO John May noted that farmer confidence has improved due to trade tensions easing and higher agricultural exports. Improved pricing power, lower production costs, and reduced warranty expenses contributed to higher operating profits in the farm and turf business, which accounts for nearly 60% of Deere's revenue.
